import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Field
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Pi

/-!
# Componentwise separability for finite products

For a reducible affine scheme, the generic algebra is a finite product of
component fields.  This lemma packages the componentwise reduction used when
checking separability of a finite symmetric quotient.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace MilneLib

universe u v

open Algebra

/-- A finite product of field extensions is formally etale exactly when each
component field extension is separable.  The finite-type assumptions are
explicit because the field criterion for formal etaleness uses them. -/
theorem formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable
    {K : Type u} {I : Type v} (A : I → Type u)
    [Field K] [Finite I] [∀ i, Field (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (A i)]
    (hfin : ∀ i, Algebra.EssFiniteType K (A i)) :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale K (∀ i, A i) ↔
      ∀ i, Algebra.IsSeparable K (A i) := by
  rw [Algebra.FormallyEtale.pi_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    letI := hfin i
    exact (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable (K := K) (L := A i)).mp (h i)
  · intro h i
    letI := hfin i
    exact (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable (K := K) (L := A i)).mpr (h i)

/-- A finite-dimensional product of field extensions is formally etale exactly
    when each component extension is separable.  Finite-dimensionality supplies
    the finite-type hypotheses required by the field criterion. -/
theorem formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable_of_finiteDimensional
    {K : Type u} {I : Type v} (A : I → Type u)
    [Field K] [Finite I] [∀ i, Field (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (A i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (A i)] :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale K (∀ i, A i) ↔
      ∀ i, Algebra.IsSeparable K (A i) := by
  apply formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable A
  intro i
  infer_instance

/-- A componentwise finite Galois presentation gives a formally etale
product algebra.  This is the direct form needed after decomposing a
reducible generic algebra into its component fields. -/
theorem formallyEtale_pi_of_isGalois
    {K : Type u} {I : Type v} (A : I → Type u)
    [Field K] [Finite I] [∀ i, Field (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (A i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (A i)] [∀ i, IsGalois K (A i)] :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale K (∀ i, A i) := by
  rw [formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable_of_finiteDimensional A]
  intro i
  exact IsGalois.to_isSeparable

/-- The componentwise criterion only needs finite generation of the whole
product algebra: evaluation onto each component transfers finite-dimensionality
to that component.  This is the form used for finite generic algebras. -/
theorem formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable_of_moduleFinite
    {K : Type u} {I : Type v} (A : I → Type u)
    [Field K] [Finite I] [∀ i, Field (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (A i)]
    [Module.Finite K (∀ i, A i)] :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale K (∀ i, A i) ↔
      ∀ i, Algebra.IsSeparable K (A i) := by
  letI : ∀ i, Module.Finite K (A i) := fun i =>
    Module.Finite.of_surjective (LinearMap.proj i) (Function.surjective_eval i)
  exact formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable_of_finiteDimensional A

/- A finite product algebra need only be module-finite globally: the projection
  maps then provide the finite-dimensional hypotheses for each component. -/
theorem formallyEtale_pi_of_isGalois_of_moduleFinite
    {K : Type u} {I : Type v} (A : I → Type u)
    [Field K] [Finite I] [∀ i, Field (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (A i)]
    [Module.Finite K (∀ i, A i)] [∀ i, IsGalois K (A i)] :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale K (∀ i, A i) := by
  rw [formallyEtale_pi_iff_componentwise_isSeparable_of_moduleFinite A]
  intro i
  exact IsGalois.to_isSeparable

end MilneLib
